id: title:Gilbert09:show trigger dev checkly and roark as inbox sources

review.posthog_relevance: Adds metadata and configuration entries for Checkly, Roark, and Trigger.dev to the desktop client and agent contracts, enabling the UI to recognize and display these external inbox sources.
review.reason: The changes are localized to metadata and configuration: P1.F1.H1 adds entries to `EXTERNAL_INBOX_SOURCES` and P1.F2.H1 adds metadata for the desktop UI. No implementation, ingestion, or validation logic is present. This represents a narrow, preparatory maintenance change rather than a substantive capability or systemic improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the absence of implementation and the localized nature of metadata-only changes. The actual benefit depends on future implementation and adoption, which are not demonstrated in this chunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk adds three new external inbox sources (Checkly, Roark, Trigger.dev) to PostHog's agent contracts and desktop UI. The changes are localized to configuration and metadata, not implementation or validation. No tier score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds Checkly, Roark, Trigger.dev entries to EXTERNAL_INBOX_SOURCES, including product, label, description, dwSourceType, requiredTables, recordKind, setup.
observations.posthog_connection: These entries enable PostHog to recognize and potentially ingest issue records from Checkly, Roark, and Trigger.dev, though no ingestion or processing implementation is shown.

observations.behavior: Adds Checkly, Roark, Trigger.dev metadata and icons to SOURCE_PRODUCT_META for desktop UI display.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the PostHog desktop client to display these new sources with appropriate icons and labels.
